values.meaning: duration of the Hunted mark applied to a hit target
values.quote: applies a ''Hunted'' mark to the target for 4 seconds
values.binNote: no bin data rows are given for slot P; the wiki's 4-second duration is not present in the sheet

mechanics.claim: Hitting an enemy champion or monster with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack applies the Hunted mark, and the first cast of Takedown and Pounce against a Hunted target is empowered.
mechanics.quote: the first cast of both ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}}'' and ''{{ai|Pounce|Nidalee}}'' against a ''Hunted'' target is enhanced

mechanics.claim: Prowl's ghosting and movement speed bonuses, and Hunt's movement speed bonus, do not affect damage dealt or taken.
